package v1

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	httpmw "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
)

// RegisterRoutes registers admin routes on the provided router.
func RegisterRoutes(r chi.Router, courseHandler *handlers.CourseHandler, trackHandler *handlers.TrackHandler, levelHandler *handlers.CourseLevelHandler, groupHandler *handlers.CourseGroupHandler, trackRelationsHandler *handlers.TrackRelationsHandler, levelRelationsHandler *handlers.LevelRelationsHandler, groupRelationsHandler *handlers.CourseGroupRelationsHandler, moduleHandler *handlers.ModuleHandler, moduleRelationsHandler *handlers.ModuleRelationsHandler, sectionHandler *handlers.SectionHandler, sectionRelationsHandler *handlers.SectionRelationsHandler, lessonHandler *handlers.LessonHandler, lessonRelationsHandler *handlers.LessonRelationsHandler, lessonExamplesHandler *handlers.LessonExamplesHandler, exampleRelationsHandler *handlers.ExampleRelationsHandler, taskHandler *handlers.TaskHandler, techHandler *handlers.TechHandler, techVersionHandler *handlers.TechVersionHandler, tagHandler *handlers.TagHandler, composeConfigHandler *handlers.ComposeConfigHandler, courseI18nHandler *handlers.CourseI18nHandler, courseRelationsHandler *handlers.CourseRelationsHandler, positionHandler *handlers.PositionHandler, positionRelationsHandler *handlers.PositionRelationsHandler, codeStructureTypeHandler *handlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler) {
	adminReadMW := httpmw.RequireRole("TEACHER", "ADMIN", "MODERATOR")
	adminWriteMW := httpmw.RequireRole("ADMIN", "MODERATOR")

	// Course
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/course/create", courseHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/course/get/{courseID}", courseHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/course/list", courseHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/course/update/{courseID}", courseHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/course/delete/{courseID}", courseHandler.Delete)

	// Course i18n
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/course-i18n/create/{courseID}", courseI18nHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/course-i18n/update/{courseID}/{i18nID}", courseI18nHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/course-i18n/delete/{courseID}/{i18nID}", courseI18nHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/course-i18n/list/{courseID}", courseI18nHandler.ListByCourse)

	// I18n list
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/i18n/list", courseI18nHandler.ListI18n)

	// Course relations
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/course-relations/update-tags/{courseID}", courseRelationsHandler.UpdateTags)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/course-relations/update-techs/{courseID}", courseRelationsHandler.UpdateTechs)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/course-relations/add-module/{courseID}", courseRelationsHandler.AddModule)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/course-relations/replace-modules/{courseID}", courseRelationsHandler.ReplaceModules)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/course-relations/delete-module/{courseID}/{moduleID}", courseRelationsHandler.DeleteModule)

	// Catalog hierarchy
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/track/create", trackHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/track/get/{trackID}", trackHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/track/list", trackHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/track/update/{trackID}", trackHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/track/delete/{trackID}", trackHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/track-relations/add-level/{trackID}", trackRelationsHandler.AddLevel)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/track-relations/replace-levels/{trackID}", trackRelationsHandler.ReplaceLevels)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/track-relations/delete-level/{trackID}/{levelID}", trackRelationsHandler.DeleteLevel)

	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/level/create", levelHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/level/get/{levelID}", levelHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/level/list", levelHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/level/update/{levelID}", levelHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/level/delete/{levelID}", levelHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/level-relations/add-course-group/{levelID}", levelRelationsHandler.AddCourseGroup)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/level-relations/replace-course-groups/{levelID}", levelRelationsHandler.ReplaceCourseGroups)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/level-relations/delete-course-group/{levelID}/{groupID}", levelRelationsHandler.DeleteCourseGroup)

	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/course-group/create", groupHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/course-group/get/{groupID}", groupHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/course-group/list", groupHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/course-group/update/{groupID}", groupHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/course-group/delete/{groupID}", groupHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/course-group-relations/add-course/{groupID}", groupRelationsHandler.AddCourse)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/course-group-relations/replace-courses/{groupID}", groupRelationsHandler.ReplaceCourses)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/course-group-relations/delete-course/{groupID}/{courseID}", groupRelationsHandler.DeleteCourse)

	// Modules
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/module/create", moduleHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/module/get/{moduleID}", moduleHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/module/list", moduleHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/module/update/{moduleID}", moduleHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/module/delete/{moduleID}", moduleHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/module-relations/add-section/{moduleID}", moduleRelationsHandler.AddSection)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/module-relations/replace-sections/{moduleID}", moduleRelationsHandler.ReplaceSections)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/module-relations/delete-section/{moduleID}/{sectionID}", moduleRelationsHandler.DeleteSection)

	// Sections
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/section/create", sectionHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/section/get/{sectionID}", sectionHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/section/list", sectionHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/section/update/{sectionID}", sectionHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/section/delete/{sectionID}", sectionHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/section-relations/add-lesson/{sectionID}", sectionRelationsHandler.AddLesson)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/section-relations/replace-lessons/{sectionID}", sectionRelationsHandler.ReplaceLessons)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/section-relations/delete-lesson/{sectionID}/{lessonID}", sectionRelationsHandler.DeleteLesson)

	// Positions
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/position/create", positionHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/position/get/{positionID}", positionHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/position/list", positionHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/position/update/{positionID}", positionHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/position/delete/{positionID}", positionHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/position-relations/update-techs/{positionID}", positionRelationsHandler.UpdateTechs)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/position-relations/update-courses/{positionID}", positionRelationsHandler.UpdateCourses)

	// Tech
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/tech/create", techHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/tech/get", techHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/tech/list", techHandler.List)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/tech/get-by-id/{techID}", techHandler.GetByID)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/tech/update/{techID}", techHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/tech/delete/{techID}", techHandler.Delete)

	// Tech versions
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/tech-version/create", techVersionHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/tech-version/list", techVersionHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/tech-version/update/{techVersionID}", techVersionHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/tech-version/delete/{techVersionID}", techVersionHandler.Delete)

	// Tags
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/tag/create", tagHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/tag/list", tagHandler.List)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/tag/get/{tagID}", tagHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/tag/update/{tagID}", tagHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/tag/delete/{tagID}", tagHandler.Delete)

	// Compose configs
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/compose-config/create", composeConfigHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/compose-config/list", composeConfigHandler.List)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/compose-config/get/{composeConfigID}", composeConfigHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/compose-config/update/{composeConfigID}", composeConfigHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/compose-config/delete/{composeConfigID}", composeConfigHandler.Delete)

	// Code structure types
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/code-structure-type/create", codeStructureTypeHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/code-structure-type/get/{codeStructureTypeID}", codeStructureTypeHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/code-structure-type/list", codeStructureTypeHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/code-structure-type/update/{codeStructureTypeID}", codeStructureTypeHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/code-structure-type/delete/{codeStructureTypeID}", codeStructureTypeHandler.Delete)

	// Lessons
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/lesson/{lessonID}/completion-policy", lessonHandler.SetCompletionPolicy)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/lesson/create", lessonHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/lesson/get/{lessonID}", lessonHandler.Get)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/lesson/list", lessonHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/lesson/update/{lessonID}", lessonHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/lesson/delete/{lessonID}", lessonHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/lesson-relations/replace/{sourceLessonID}", lessonRelationsHandler.Replace)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/lesson-relations/list/{sourceLessonID}", lessonRelationsHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/lesson-relations/delete/{relationID}", lessonRelationsHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/lesson-examples/replace/{lessonID}", lessonExamplesHandler.Replace)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/lesson-examples/list/{lessonID}", lessonExamplesHandler.ListAdmin)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/lesson-examples/delete/{exampleID}", lessonExamplesHandler.Delete)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/example-relations/replace/{sourceExampleID}", exampleRelationsHandler.Replace)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/example-relations/list/{sourceExampleID}", exampleRelationsHandler.ListAdmin)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/example-relations/delete/{relationID}", exampleRelationsHandler.Delete)

	// Tasks - full CRUD
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/task/create", taskHandler.Create)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/task/get/{taskID}", taskHandler.GetAdmin)
	r.With(adminReadMW).Get("/task/list", taskHandler.List)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Put("/task/update/{taskID}", taskHandler.Update)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Post("/task/{taskID}/starter-files/upload", taskHandler.UploadStarterFiles)
	r.With(adminWriteMW).Delete("/task/delete/{taskID}", taskHandler.Delete)
}

// NewRouter builds a router with admin routes.
func NewRouter(courseHandler *handlers.CourseHandler, trackHandler *handlers.TrackHandler, levelHandler *handlers.CourseLevelHandler, groupHandler *handlers.CourseGroupHandler, trackRelationsHandler *handlers.TrackRelationsHandler, levelRelationsHandler *handlers.LevelRelationsHandler, groupRelationsHandler *handlers.CourseGroupRelationsHandler, moduleHandler *handlers.ModuleHandler, moduleRelationsHandler *handlers.ModuleRelationsHandler, sectionHandler *handlers.SectionHandler, sectionRelationsHandler *handlers.SectionRelationsHandler, lessonHandler *handlers.LessonHandler, lessonRelationsHandler *handlers.LessonRelationsHandler, lessonExamplesHandler *handlers.LessonExamplesHandler, exampleRelationsHandler *handlers.ExampleRelationsHandler, taskHandler *handlers.TaskHandler, techHandler *handlers.TechHandler, techVersionHandler *handlers.TechVersionHandler, tagHandler *handlers.TagHandler, composeConfigHandler *handlers.ComposeConfigHandler, courseI18nHandler *handlers.CourseI18nHandler, courseRelationsHandler *handlers.CourseRelationsHandler, positionHandler *handlers.PositionHandler, positionRelationsHandler *handlers.PositionRelationsHandler, codeStructureTypeHandler *handlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler) chi.Router {
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	RegisterRoutes(r, courseHandler, trackHandler, levelHandler, groupHandler, trackRelationsHandler, levelRelationsHandler, groupRelationsHandler, moduleHandler, moduleRelationsHandler, sectionHandler, sectionRelationsHandler, lessonHandler, lessonRelationsHandler, lessonExamplesHandler, exampleRelationsHandler, taskHandler, techHandler, techVersionHandler, tagHandler, composeConfigHandler, courseI18nHandler, courseRelationsHandler, positionHandler, positionRelationsHandler, codeStructureTypeHandler)
	return r
}
